message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023.  
(Only federal holidays that create a three‑day weekend are listed; provincial holidays that also create long weekends are noted where applicable.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Observed on Monday, **January 2** (since Jan 1 fell on a Sunday) | **December 30–January 2** (Sat–Mon) | Includes the preceding weekend. |
| **Family Day** | Monday, **February 20** | **February 18–20** (Sat–Mon) | Celebrated in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island, and Newfoundland & Labrador. |
| **Good Friday** | Friday, **April 7** | **April 7–9** (Fri–Sun) | |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday, **May 22** | **May 20–22** (Sat–Mon) | |
| **Canada Day** | Observed on Monday, **July 3** (since July 1 was a Saturday) | **July 1–3** (Sat–Mon) | |
| **Labour Day** | Monday, **September 4** | **September 2–4** (Sat–Mon) | |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday, **October 9** | **October 7–9** (Sat–Mon) | |
| **Remembrance Day** | Friday, **November 11** | **November 11–13** (Fri–Sun) | |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday, **December 25** | **December 23–25** (Sat–Mon) | |

> **Boxing Day** falls on Tuesday, December 26, 2023, so it does not create a long weekend.

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app! If you need provincial holidays that also create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.), let me know and I can add those too.
